app.name: Tempo
app.primary_job: Read agent work, edit a project, and manage chats

screen.name: Workspace sidebar
screen.purpose: Find a project and switch between its workspaces

focus_content_share.instructions: In the images, how much of the screen goes to the user's own content, compared to controls, banners, and decoration?
criteria: Controls, banners, promotions, or decoration take most of the screen
Content and controls take similar space
The user's content takes most of the screen, and controls sit in a sidebar, a header, or a footer

focus_reading_order.instructions: Do the images show a clear reading order: navigation at one edge, then a page title, then the main content?

focus_space_fit.instructions: In the images, does each panel's width fit its content, with no large panel that holds only a few items?

overflow_long_text.instructions: In the images, how does long text, such as names, titles, and file paths, fit its space?

criteria.ellipsis: It is cut at the end with an ellipsis, and the layout stays the same
criteria.cut: It is cut with no ellipsis, or cut in the middle of a letter
criteria.breaks_layout: It wraps or pushes other elements out of place
criteria.not_shown: No text in the images is too long for its space

overflow_scroll_cue.instructions: In the images, when a region scrolls, does it show that more content exists?

criteria.cue: Yes: a partly visible item, a fade, a shadow, or a scrollbar shows more content
criteria.no_cue: The region ends at an item edge, with no sign that more content exists
criteria.not_shown: No region in the images scrolls

quality_long_lines.instructions: In the images, do lines of body text run very long, much wider than a comfortable paragraph?

quality_text_covered.instructions: In the images, does an element cover text that the user needs to read?

quality_overflow.instructions: In the images, does content spill out of its container, or is a menu, a tooltip, or a popover cut off?

quality_scroll_edge.instructions: In the images, does scrolled content run under a fixed header or tab bar with no divider or shadow, so the content looks cut off?

type_hierarchy.instructions: Do the images show clear type hierarchy, made with size, weight, and grey tone, with at most two type families?

type_scale.instructions: In the images, how are text sizes and weights used?
criteria: Many sizes with small differences, or no clear pattern
A few sizes, but some styles look almost the same
A small set of clearly different sizes and weights, used the same way for the same role everywhere

type_numbers.instructions: In the images, in tables or columns of numbers, do the digits line up?

criteria.aligned: Digits line up in columns, and numbers align to the right or on a shared edge
criteria.ragged: Digits do not line up, so values are hard to compare
criteria.not_shown: The images show no columns of numbers

type_mono.instructions: In the images, what font do code, commands, IDs, and file paths use?

criteria.mono: A monospace font, often on a subtle background
criteria.mixed: Some use monospace and some use the body font
criteria.not_shown: The images show no code, commands, IDs, or file paths
